title: Before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having been encouraged by Sweep Tosho's efforts, Zenno Rob Roy wins the autumn Tenno Sho and declares that she'll conquer the upcoming Japan Cup too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Sweep Tosho forces me to decide which race will serve as the stage for her contest against the Triple Crown tour runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But which race would make a grand enough stage for her to cast her magic on the whole world? The answer will depend on how the Queen Elizabeth II Cup plays out today.
